user.title: Connect to OpenClaw
user.description: Enter your OpenClaw gateway details. Run `openclaw gateway status` to find the address and token.

data_description.gateway_url: WebSocket URL of your OpenClaw gateway — e.g. ws://192.168.1.50:18789
data_description.token: Auth token from your gateway config (gateway.auth.token). Leave blank if auth is disabled.
data_description.session_key: Leave blank to auto-create a dedicated 'homeassistant' session, or paste a session key from the OpenClaw Control UI

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure OpenClaw connection
reconfigure.description: Update the gateway URL, auth token, or session key.

data_description.gateway_url: WebSocket URL of your OpenClaw gateway — e.g. ws://192.168.1.50:18789
data_description.token: Auth token from your gateway config. Leave blank if auth is disabled.
data_description.session_key: The OpenClaw session key that Home Assistant should talk to

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the OpenClaw gateway — check the URL and make sure OpenClaw is running

abort.already_configured: This OpenClaw gateway is already configured

data_description.session_key: The OpenClaw session key to route messages to. Change this to switch sessions without reconnecting.
data_description.system_prompt: Text prepended to every message sent to OpenClaw. Leave blank to send the user message as-is.
